changelog:
- Quotes in the article text: italic text font, set in from a side line in the primary colour (Styles: Quote side line colour and width); FAQ answer quotes use the same line
- Release 0.20.0
- Article list: 'Hide from the blog list' switch per article (also skipped by automatic Keep reading); cards show the hero video poster or social image when there is no featured image; list pages 2+ get their own description and /page/ and /page/1/ redirect to the list
- Pagination: the current page uses the primary button colours and the site's box corners (square when Box corners = 0); text that is the same colour as its background is shown in white/black by the build, and the Styles tab now also warns for colours typed as variables
- FAQ answers are tidied into semantic HTML (loose text gets a paragraph, loose list items a list, tables scroll sideways on phones) and styled like the article text: lists, bold, links, quotes, code, tables
